kai.description: A cheerful, busy Thai auntie in her forties who sells salted eggs at a village market. Quick, bright, slightly high voice, a little flustered when worried and delighted when things go right. Speaks English with a northern Thai accent, like a funny animated movie character.

nak.description: A sweet old Thai grandmother in her eighties, slow, gentle and a little wobbly, with a soft giggle, calls everyone dear. Speaks English with a northern Thai accent. A cartoon otter grandma character talking to a five-year-old.

saltaunty.description: A chubby, funny Thai aunty in her fifties from a mountain village in northern Thailand, speaking English with a warm northern Thai accent. Kind and playful with a twinkle in her voice and a little giggle, a bit of a tease, talking to a five-year-old in a cartoon.

kwai.description: A big, jolly Thai uncle in his sixties, a deep booming warm voice that laughs from the belly, a bit dramatic about his cooking. Speaks English with a northern Thai accent. A cartoon water buffalo character talking to a five-year-old.
